terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.desc: Terms of sale for Tichnun Plus digital planners: what you buy, payment, delivery, licence and support.
terms.body:
Seller: איתן כהן, trading as Tichnun Plus ("we", "us"), Israel. Contact: eitanco2005@gmail.com.

1. What we sell

Digital spreadsheet templates (.xlsx files for Excel and Google Sheets) and related documents, described on each product page. Screenshots show the included example file. Nothing physical is shipped.

2. Prices and payment

Prices are in US dollars and are final; there are no hidden fees. Payment is processed by PayPal (PayPal account, or debit/credit card through PayPal's guest checkout). Your bank may charge a foreign-transaction fee because the seller is based outside the US.

3. Delivery

After payment you are taken straight to a download page with your files. Keep the link to download again. If anything goes wrong, email us with your PayPal order number and we will send the files.

4. Licence

You may use the files for your own personal and family planning, on all your devices, and share them with the people you plan with (partner, family, your event planner). You may not resell, publish or redistribute the files or modified versions of them.

5. Refunds

See the refund policy.

6. No professional advice

The planners and calculators provide general planning tools. Example figures and suggested splits are illustrations, not financial advice; customs and religious requirements vary, so follow your rabbi and your community. You are responsible for checking your figures.

7. Liability

We take care to make the files work as described. To the extent permitted by law, our liability for any purchase is limited to the amount you paid for it.

8. Privacy

See the privacy policy.

9. Changes and contact

We may update these terms; the version on the date of your purchase applies to it. Questions: email us at the address above.

refund.title: Refund policy
refund.desc: Refund policy for Tichnun Plus digital downloads: when we refund and how to ask.
refund.body:
Seller: איתן כהן, trading as Tichnun Plus ("we", "us"), Israel. Contact: eitanco2005@gmail.com.

In short: these are instant digital downloads, so we can't take them back. But if a file is faulty, doesn't open, or is materially different from its description and we can't fix it, you get a full refund.

1. When we refund

Within 14 days of purchase we refund the full amount if:

  • the file is faulty or won't open in Excel 2016 or newer or in Google Sheets, and we can't solve it;
  • the product is materially different from its description on the product page;
  • you were accidentally charged twice for the same product;
  • you didn't get access to your files and we couldn't send them within 3 business days of your email.

We don't refund simply because the product is no longer needed after it has been downloaded.

2. How to ask

  1. Email us with your order number (shown on your download page and in PayPal's receipt) and a short description of the problem.
  2. We'll first try to help, for example by sending a fixed file. If that doesn't solve it, we refund.
  3. Refunds go back through PayPal to the original payment method, normally within 14 days of approval.

This policy does not limit any rights you have under the consumer law that applies to you.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.desc: How Tichnun Plus handles your data: no ad trackers, minimal visit counts, PayPal for payments.
privacy.body:
Seller: איתן כהן, trading as Tichnun Plus ("we", "us"), Israel. Contact: eitanco2005@gmail.com.

We collect as little as possible. No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers, no mailing lists.

1. What we collect

  • Visit counts: the page path, the referring website (host name only), device type (phone/tablet/desktop), browser language and time. No name, email or personal identifier, and no cookies.
  • Purchases: the PayPal order number, product, amount and currency, to deliver the product, keep accounts and give support.
  • Email: if you write to us, your address and message, only to answer you.
  • Free calculators: what you type is calculated in your browser and never sent to us.
  • Local storage: your browser may keep your light/dark preference and a list of your orders so you can find your download page again. It stays on your device.

2. Payments through PayPal

You pay on PayPal's systems; card details never reach us. PayPal shares the transaction details and the contact details it gives sellers (such as the payer's name and email), as described in PayPal's privacy statement. We use them only for the order, support and accounting.

3. Service providers

  • PayPal: payments.
  • Netlify: website hosting; may log technical access data such as IP addresses for security.
  • Google Fonts: the site font; Google receives your IP address when the font loads.
  • Google Drive / Sheets: if you upload a planner there, it's stored in your own Google account; we have no access.

We never sell or share personal information for marketing.

4. Retention and your rights

Purchase records are kept as long as accounting law requires (usually up to 7 years). You can ask to see, correct or delete information we hold about you by emailing us. If you live in a US state with a privacy law (such as California), you have the rights that law gives you; we do not sell or share personal information as those laws define it.

5. Changes

If this policy changes we'll update the date at the top.
